claims.claim: TFSA withdrawals are added back to contribution room only at the start of the next calendar year.
claims.episode_span: Если вы выводите деньги из TFSA, эта сумма не возвращается в ваш лимит взносов сразу же. Нужно ждать начала следующего календарного года.
claims.source_title: The TFSA Withdrawal Rule Every Canadian Should Know
claims.supporting_quote: The part Canadians sometimes forget is that you have to wait until the next calendar year to get that withdrawal amount added back to your contribution room limit.
